title: 第七章 我在百城大战等着你第八章 自己拿回来

read2（）;丹药刚一入口，便化作一股清香的热流从喉咙急流而下，冲入林无缺的体内，顿时一股狂暴无比的力量伴随着惊人的热力在身体内炸开！
金红气血和圣道战气在这一瞬间似乎察觉到了这股来自外在的炙热庞大的力量，在林无缺的心念运转下齐齐扑向人级爆灵丹所爆发出来的药力洪流。
“唰”“嗡”
感受着体内瞬间便沸腾起来的状况，林无缺面无表情，抱元守一，将全部的心念用在指挥金红气血和圣道战气之上，他要以自身的气血和元力去将人级爆灵丹的药力化开并逐渐吸收。
这过程或许会凶险无比，或许真的会如同空所说的那样是在赌，但林无缺早已将心中的恐惧压制住，这一刻的他余下的只有竭尽全力的去...赌命！
“嘭”
就在林无缺一心一意控制体内金红气血和圣道战气的时候，人级爆灵丹的药力开始发作！
“咚、咚、咚！”
“我的身体，皮、肉、筋一同震荡了起来。”
虽然紧闭双眼，但林无缺还是清晰的感受到自己身体的每一分变化。
他的每一寸皮肤开始轻轻的颤抖，肉身开始剧烈抖动，而在体内，一条条早已被炼透的筋脉亦在齐齐蠕动！
“轰”
出乎林无缺的意料，人级爆灵丹的药力比他想象中还要强上太多太多，且其蔓延的速度更是奇快无比，几个呼吸下便以近乎充斥了林无缺体内的每一寸血肉和筋脉，与金红气血和圣道战气轰然交汇在了一起！
一声闷哼，一股从体内突然爆发出来的巨大撕裂的痛苦刹时淹没了林无缺的心神，仿佛此时有个巨人正在自己的体内肆掠破坏。所过之处，筋脉虬结，血肉沸腾，刚刚吞下人级爆灵丹不过十个呼吸的时间，林无缺所承受的痛苦便以展开并达到了极致！
而、这只是刚刚开始.....人级爆灵丹！
顾名思义，正是此丹带来的一个狂暴无比的力量。人体内部本就脆弱无比，轻微的震荡或伤害便能使人重伤乃至丧命。
作为三品下阶，人级爆灵丹虽然可以提升锻体境修士元力三个等级，但修士必然要承担此丹所带来的风险，其一便是皮、肉、筋、骨、髓的同时震荡，再者就是将突破的痛苦三而合一，以狂暴的药力去冲击炼骨与炼髓境，不成功便成仁！
熬过去修为大涨，元力飙升三个等级，熬不过去筋脉寸断，爆体而亡！
机率五五之分。

这、也就是所谓赌命的含义。
林无缺早已经无法去思考，他的心神被巨大的痛楚淹没，盘坐着的肉身被道道淡金色的圣道战气掩盖，一股股狂暴的力量从体内宣泄而出，皮肉筋骨髓仿佛火中浇油，彻底的燃烧而起。
人级爆灵丹所带来的药力与金红气血和圣道战气汇成了一股沛然的力量游走在林无缺的体内！
骨膜震颤，每一块骨头都在疯狂的挤压，这其中仿佛骨头断裂的痛苦不断的发生，林无缺感觉自己的骨头不停地被碾碎又瞬间恢复，来回不停，催人欲死。
而锻体境最关键的炼髓阶段也以这种蛮横霸道的方式开始，一股比之先前更强十倍的痛苦之感袭上心头，若非先前刚刚受过凝聚圣法本源的痛苦，林无缺此刻必然已经失去了知觉。
紧紧守住灵台中的最后一丝清明，林无缺苦苦的熬着，以最后的心念去下意识的运转金红气血和圣道战气以及人级爆灵丹药力所汇聚成的这股力量。
肉身和筋脉的承受能力已经达到了饱和状态，接下来若稍有不慎，便是爆体而亡的结果。
然而，在剧烈的痛楚之下，好似福至心灵，林无缺却渐渐的进入了一种奇妙的境界，无思无念，仿佛沉睡在梦里，痛苦虽然依旧强烈，但比之刚刚的炼骨和炼髓所带来生不如死的感觉好上了一些。
也就在这一刻，汇聚而成的狂暴力量来到了林无缺的丹田，接着便以迅猛无比的势头冲了进去，这股力量瞬间就和斗战圣法本源光团接触到了一起！
“轰”
神秘无比、腾腾跳动的圣法本源本来对于这股肆掠在林无缺体内的力量不闻不顾，任由它改变着林无缺身体的每一寸血肉、筋脉和骨髓，但此刻这股狂暴力量似乎结束了对于林无缺皮肉筋骨髓的熬炼，转而冲进了丹田之处。
这一举动仿佛侵犯了圣法本源的威严，那股磅礴、宏大、至强的战之气息在狂暴力量进入丹田的一瞬间便轰然从圣法本源光团中涌出，以摧枯拉朽之势将其引入了圣法本源，犹如鲸吞牛饮一般瞬间吞的干干净净，接着又被圣法本源重新释放出来。
只是再度出现的这股力量不再狂暴肆掠，虽然依旧庞大，但变得温和细腻，冲出了丹田，回到了林无缺的体内，如同润物细无声般悄然滋润和洗炼着皮肉筋骨髓。
在圣法本源的神奇作用之下，林无缺终究扛过了人级爆灵丹的狂暴之力。
林无缺对此没有丝毫的感觉，他整个心神沉浸在了那种奇妙的境界当中，无想无念，自然也发现不了他的气息正一点一滴的变强着，圣道战气和金红气血再度回归肉身，伴随着那股温和细腻的力量，悄然无声的改变着林无缺肉身的每一个地方。
五五之分的赌命，林无缺因为圣法本源而赌赢了。
“嗡”“哗啦啦”
山洞内盘坐着的林无缺周身一片光辉，神魂空间内亦是平静无比，空似乎也失去了所有气息，圣道战气淡金色的光芒将其笼罩，仿佛形成了一个巨大的金茧。
林无缺不知道，待到他功成破茧的那一日，将会有着一个巨大的惊喜等着自己。
时间一点一滴的流逝着，修炼无岁月，山洞内没有了声息，余下的是一个被团淡金色光芒围绕的盘坐人影。

read2(); As soon as the elixir was taken into his mouth, it turned into a stream of fragrant heat rushing down his throat and rushed into Lin Wuque's body. Suddenly, a violent force exploded in his body along with astonishing heat!
At this moment, the golden blood and holy battle energy seemed to be aware of this hot and huge power from the outside, and under the movement of Lin Wuque's mind, they all rushed towards the torrent of medicinal power erupted by the human-level explosive spirit pill.
"Shua" "Buzz"
Feeling the boiling situation within his body, Lin Wuque had no expression on his face, hugged Yuan Shouyi, and devoted all his thoughts to commanding the golden red energy and blood and the holy battle energy. He wanted to use his own energy, blood and energy to dissolve the power of the human-level Explosive Spirit Pill and gradually absorb it.
This process may be extremely dangerous, or it may really be gambling as Kong said, but Lin Wuque has already suppressed the fear in his heart. At this moment, all he has left is to try his best to... gamble his life!
"Bang"
Just when Lin Wuque was concentrating on controlling the golden red blood and holy battle energy in his body, the power of the human-level Explosive Spiritual Pill began to take effect!
"Boom, boom, boom!"
"My body, skin, flesh, and tendons were shaking together."
Although he closed his eyes tightly, Lin Wuque could still clearly feel every change in his body.
Every inch of his skin began to tremble slightly, his body began to shake violently, and inside his body, the muscles and veins that had been forged long ago were also squirming!
"Boom"
To Lin Wuque's expectation, the power of the human-level Explosive Spiritual Pill was much stronger than he imagined, and its spread was extremely fast. In just a few breaths, it almost filled every inch of flesh, flesh, and veins in Lin Wuque's body, and it suddenly merged with the golden-red blood and holy battle energy!
With a muffled groan, a huge tearing pain suddenly burst out from his body and instantly overwhelmed Lin Wuque's mind, as if a giant was wreaking havoc inside his body. Wherever he passed, the muscles and veins were knotted, and the blood and flesh boiled. Just ten breaths after swallowing the human-level explosive spirit pill, the pain Lin Wuque endured began to unfold and reach its extreme!
And, this is just the beginning... the human-level explosive elixir!
As the name suggests, it is the extremely violent power brought by this elixir. The human body is extremely fragile internally, and a slight shock or injury can cause serious injury or even death.
As a lower-level third-level person, although the human-level Explosive Spiritual Pill can increase the energy of monks in the body-forging realm by three levels, the monks must bear the risks brought by this pill. One is the simultaneous shock of skin, flesh, tendons, bones, and marrow. The other is to combine the pain of breakthrough into one and use violent medicinal power to attack the bone-refining and marrow-refining realms. If they fail, they will become benevolent!
After surviving it, his cultivation level increased greatly, and his Yuanli soared by three levels. But when he couldn't survive it, his muscles and veins were severed, and his body exploded and died!
The odds are 50 to 50.
This is the meaning of gambling on life.
Lin Wuque had long been unable to think. His mind was overwhelmed by the huge pain. His body sitting cross-legged was covered by the light golden holy battle energy. Violent power was released from his body. His skin, flesh, tendons and marrow seemed to be adding fuel to the fire, completely burning.
The medicinal power brought by the human-level explosive elixir, the golden red blood and the holy battle energy merged into a powerful force that roamed Lin Wuque's body!
The periosteum was trembling, and every bone was being squeezed crazily. It was as if the pain of broken bones was constantly occurring. Lin Wuque felt that his bones were constantly being crushed and then restored instantly, going back and forth, which was almost exhilarating.
The most critical marrow refining stage of the body training realm also started in this arrogant and overbearing way. A feeling of pain that was ten times stronger than before hit his heart. If he had not just suffered the pain of condensing the source of the holy law, Lin Wuque must have lost consciousness at this moment.
Holding tightly to the last trace of clarity in the spiritual platform, Lin Wuque endured painstakingly, using his last thoughts to subconsciously circulate the golden red energy.This force is formed by the blood, the fighting energy of the Holy Path, and the power of the human-level Explosive Spiritual Pill.
The endurance capacity of the physical body and muscles has reached saturation. If you are not careful next time, your body will explode and die.
However, under the severe pain, as if his soul was blessed, Lin Wuque gradually entered a wonderful state, without thoughts or thoughts, as if sleeping in a dream. Although the pain was still intense, it was better than the feeling of life being worse than death caused by the bone refining and marrow refining just now.
At this moment, the violent force gathered together came to Lin Wuque's Dantian, and then rushed in with extremely fast momentum. This force instantly came into contact with the original light group of the Holy Law of Fighting!
"Boom"
The extremely mysterious, pulsating source of the Holy Law originally ignored this force that ravaged Lin Wuque's body, allowing it to change every inch of flesh, blood, tendons, and bone marrow in Lin Wuque's body. But at this moment, this violent force seemed to have ended the training of Lin Wuque's skin, flesh, tendons, and marrow, and instead rushed into the Dantian.
This move seemed to violate the majesty of the source of the Holy Law. The majestic, grand, and powerful aura of war burst out from the light group of the Source of the Holy Law the moment the violent force entered the Dantian, and introduced it into the Origin of the Holy Law with a devastating force. It was swallowed up cleanly in an instant like a whale swallowing a cow, and then was released by the source of the Holy Law again.
However, the power that reappeared no longer raged wildly. Although it was still huge, it became gentle and delicate. It rushed out of the dantian and returned to Lin Wuque's body, quietly nourishing and refining the skin, flesh, tendons, and marrow like moisturizing things.
Under the magical effect of the source of the holy law, Lin Wuque finally withstood the violent power of the human-level explosive spirit pill.
Lin Wuque had no feeling at all about this. His whole mind was immersed in that wonderful state, without any thought. Naturally, he could not notice that his aura was getting stronger bit by bit. The holy battle energy and golden red blood returned to the body again. Along with that gentle and delicate power, it silently changed every part of Lin Wuque's body.
Lin Wuque won the 50-50 bet because of the origin of the holy law.
"Buzz" and "buzz"
Lin Wuque, who was sitting cross-legged in the cave, was surrounded by radiance, and the soul space was also extremely calm. Kong seemed to have lost all his breath, and the pale golden light of the Holy Path's battle energy shrouded him, as if forming a huge golden cocoon.
Lin Wuque didn't know that there would be a huge surprise waiting for him on the day he successfully broke out of his cocoon.
Time passed bit by bit, and there were no years of cultivation. There was no sound in the cave, and what was left was a figure sitting cross-legged surrounded by a pale golden light.
